This guide covers the normal development workflow. Architecture, testing, and
the Storage format are maintained as separate canonical documents:

- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Testing and validation](TESTING.md)
- [Storage reference](../reference/STORAGE.md)

Public model syntax is specified by the [homo](../reference/HOMO.md) and
[copo](../reference/COPO.md) references. The supported Python interface is
documented in the [pyslimmc API reference](../reference/PYSLIMMC_API.md).

## 1. Development workflow

Use Nim 2.2.x and Python. Core `pyslimmc` requires only NumPy; the `test`
extra installs pytest plus the optional Matplotlib dependency needed by plotting tests.
Install the Python packages in editable mode:

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[test]" -e ./pyslimmc_opt
```

The root Makefile is the normal entry point:

```bash
make info
make build
make test-fast
make test
make test-devel
make test-full
```

`make build` creates the unified `bin/slimmc` dispatcher and
`bin/slimmc-summary`. `make build-engines` additionally builds the standalone
homo and copo binaries used during engine development.

### 1.1 Selecting Python

Makefiles default to `python`, so an activated virtual or Conda environment is
used naturally. Override it explicitly when needed:

```bash
make test PYTHON=/path/to/python
make python-info PYTHON=/path/to/python
```

Root targets do not overwrite `PYTHONPATH`. Component validation targets
prepend the repository root while preserving an existing value, which is
important on module-based HPC systems such as PLGrid.

### 1.2 Change contract

Every change must update all affected layers in the same commit:

| Change | Required companions |
|---|---|
| public model syntax | parser tests, `--check` examples, homo/copo manual |
| public pyslimmc API | tests, type surface where present, [`../reference/PYSLIMMC_API.md`](../reference/PYSLIMMC_API.md) |
| Storage schema | both applicable writers, reader, validator, fixture, this guide |
| chemistry or SSA behavior | focused unit test, black-box invariant, public-API check |
| example | model preflight, readable analysis, README, reference plot |

Obsolete public names are removed rather than retained as undocumented aliases.
Validated scientific contracts and fixtures must remain unless a deliberate
contract change updates their expected invariants.

### 1.3 Versions and release checks

Slimmc CLI, homo, and copo share one Slimmc version. pyslimmc and
pyslimmc-opt have independent PEP 440 versions. Before a release run:

```bash
make check-versions
make check-release-config
python scripts/check_documentation.py
make test-full
make clean
```

Release and tag procedures are documented in [`RELEASES.md`](RELEASES.md).
